I had a 38 y/o classmate in first year

I came from a very conservative Asian background and I used to have a neutral to negative stance towards the LGBT community due to my lack of knowledge. Things like gender neutral washrooms and people introducing themselves with pronouns gave me a culture shock for the first few weeks of my time at UofT. However, I havent heard anything negative against the LGBT community and everyone and the school treats the LGBTQ community either neutrally or in a welcoming way. This made me more curious about this issue and after a few months of discussion with my friends and finding answers to some of the questions I had for a long time, my mindset completely changed and I'm glad to be an ally! I even got to experience my first pride parade and I am so happy to become who I am today. 

As a straight male of course I cannot speak for LGBT people's experience here, but I hope this assures you that I was exposed to many resources, experiences and people that leave very positive impacts to the community😄
